events.definition: Dense localized lymphoid aggregates occupy host stroma immediately outside a confirmed tumor boundary.
visual_cues: compact lymphoid clusters adjacent to tumor edge
peripheral stromal lymphocytes without intranest permeation
exclusion_cues: lymphoid tissue with no demonstrable tumor-host boundary
events.prognostic_rationale: Peritumoral inflammation is a distinct spatial category in the cohort-derived ccRCC microenvironment ontology.
required_context: a verified tumor-host interface extending beyond a cropped local field
confounders: intrarenal lymphoid aggregate remote from tumor
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing lymphoid aggregates beside renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating compact lymphocyte clusters adjacent to tumor
histologic section characterized by peripheral stromal lymphoid aggregates
microscopic H&E appearance of lymphoid organization near a renal tumor boundary

events.definition: Irregular tumor groups interdigitate with and entrap native renal tubules or glomeruli at a confirmed tumor boundary.
visual_cues: carcinoma nests between native renal tubules
entrapped glomeruli at an irregular tumor edge
exclusion_cues: native tubules located within an unverified tumor-like region
events.prognostic_rationale: Infiltrative growth has cohort evidence in ccRCC, but a true tumor-host interface is needed for interpretation.
required_context: a confirmed tumor-parenchyma interface across adjacent fields or WSI context
confounders: entrapped tubules inside an expansile tumor
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing irregular renal carcinoma groups among native tubules
photomicrograph demonstrating tumor nests interdigitating with renal parenchyma
histologic section characterized by entrapped tubules and glomeruli beside carcinoma
microscopic H&E appearance of an irregular tumor-parenchyma interface

events.event_name: Tumor budding at an invasive front
events.definition: Single tumor cells or tiny clusters detach from larger nests at a confirmed advancing tumor-host interface.
visual_cues: isolated malignant cells near larger tumor nests
tiny detached tumor clusters in interface stroma
exclusion_cues: artifactual fragments floating in empty spaces
events.prognostic_rationale: Budding is a plausible local invasion phenotype, but its reproducibility and ccRCC-specific evidence are limited.
required_context: a verified advancing tumor-host boundary and continuity with the main tumor
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing small detached renal carcinoma clusters in interface stroma
photomicrograph demonstrating isolated tumor cells beside larger renal carcinoma nests
histologic section characterized by tiny carcinoma buds near a tumor boundary
microscopic H&E appearance of tumor-cell detachment at a renal carcinoma interface

events.event_name: Immune exclusion at a tumor margin
events.definition: Lymphocytes accumulate in host stroma at a confirmed tumor margin while adjacent viable tumor nests remain sparsely infiltrated.
visual_cues: dense stromal lymphocytes beside immune-sparse tumor
sharp spatial separation of lymphocytes and viable carcinoma
events.prognostic_rationale: Immune exclusion is an exploratory spatial interaction requiring interface context rather than a single arbitrary tumor patch.
required_context: a confirmed margin with both peritumoral stroma and adjacent viable tumor across sufficient area
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing stromal lymphocytes separated from viable renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating lymphocyte-rich stroma beside immune-sparse tumor nests
histologic section characterized by spatial separation of lymphocytes and carcinoma
microscopic H&E appearance of an immune-rich stromal and immune-sparse tumor interface

events.definition: Tumor traverses a pre-existing fibrous pseudocapsule into surrounding tissue on an oriented tumor-boundary section.
visual_cues: tumor nests crossing a fibrous rim
discontinuous capsule with outward tumor tongues
exclusion_cues: tumor confined to one side of an intact collagenous band
events.prognostic_rationale: Capsular penetration is a boundary event whose anatomic meaning cannot be established from an isolated patch.
required_context: oriented gross and WSI confirmation that the collagenous band is the tumor pseudocapsule
confounders: tangential sectioning of an intact capsule
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing renal carcinoma nests crossing a fibrous band
photomicrograph demonstrating tumor tongues traversing collagenous tissue
histologic section characterized by carcinoma on both sides of a fibrous rim
microscopic H&E appearance of renal tumor crossing a collagenous boundary

events.definition: Tumor involves renal sinus soft tissue, fat, or endothelial-lined spaces on appropriately sampled hilar-interface sections.
visual_cues: tumor contacting sinus-type fat or loose tissue
tumor within an endothelial-lined space in renal sinus tissue
exclusion_cues: adipose tissue without proven sinus location
peripheral tumor-fat contact remote from the hilum
events.prognostic_rationale: Renal sinus invasion is a consensus staging parameter that requires gross orientation and targeted interface sampling.
required_context: gross or WSI confirmation of renal sinus location and an adequately sampled tumor-sinus interface
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing renal carcinoma adjacent to adipose tissue and large vascular structures
photomicrograph demonstrating irregular tumor extension into loose fatty soft tissue
histologic section characterized by renal tumor among adipocytes and vascular channels
microscopic H&E appearance of a renal tumor and fatty tissue interface

events.definition: Tumor directly touches or extends as irregular tongues into perinephric tissue on an oriented outer renal interface.
visual_cues: irregular carcinoma tongues among mature adipocytes
tumor directly contacting fat beyond the renal boundary
exclusion_cues: adipocytes within an unlocalized tumor field
smooth contact without confirmation of outer renal location
events.prognostic_rationale: Perinephric fat invasion is a consensus staging parameter requiring multiple oriented interface sections.
required_context: gross and WSI confirmation of the outer renal-perinephric interface with adequate sampling
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing renal carcinoma cells among mature adipocytes
photomicrograph demonstrating irregular tumor tongues extending through fatty tissue
histologic section characterized by carcinoma nests dissecting between adipocytes
microscopic H&E appearance of a renal tumor and adipose tissue interface

events.definition: A grossly identified renal or caval venous lumen contains cohesive tumor, with wall attachment assessed on oriented sections.
visual_cues: large venous lumen occupied by cohesive carcinoma
tumor mass associated with venous wall, blood, or fibrin
events.prognostic_rationale: Major-vein extension is a staging event whose interpretation depends on gross identification and oriented sampling.
required_context: gross designation of the renal vein or vena cava and oriented wall or margin sampling
confounders: tissue displacement into a vascular space
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing a large blood-filled vessel containing cohesive renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating viable tumor associated with a venous wall and fibrin
histologic section characterized by a large vascular lumen occupied by carcinoma
microscopic H&E appearance of cohesive renal tumor within a large vessel

curation_metadata.curator: Codex-assisted computational pathology curation; independent genitourinary-pathologist review pending
criteria: Core events must be directly observable in one 448x448 H&E patch at 20x.
Core size must be 20-25 and invasion must not dominate the distribution.
ISUP consensus features receive priority when locally observable.
Cohort-supported architecture and cytology are retained only when visually separable.
Anatomic and boundary-dependent diagnoses are isolated in a context catalog.
Lower-specificity, redundant, or strongly artifact-sensitive events remain reserve candidates.
All decisions remain pending independent genitourinary-pathologist review.

decisions.reason: Requires confirmation that the lymphoid aggregate lies outside a genuine tumor boundary.
A true tumor-parenchyma boundary must be established across adjacent fields or WSI context.
Requires a verified advancing front and is vulnerable to fragmentation and inflammatory-cell mimics.
Spatial exclusion cannot be inferred reliably without sufficient tumor-margin context.
An isolated fibrous band cannot be identified reliably as the tumor pseudocapsule.
Requires gross hilar orientation and directed renal-sinus interface sampling.
Tumor plus fat in one patch cannot establish perinephric rather than sinus or intratumoral location.
Major-vein identity and wall or margin relationship require gross and WSI orientation.
